$schema_note: Terms this chapter treats as defined and which carry operative weight. THIS REGISTER DID NOT EXIST FOR THE FIRST TWO DOMAINS. Neither Banxico 34/2010 nor SI 2017/752 needed one: their hard content sat in open readings, registered as ambiguities. Here a large part of it sits in defined terms instead, and a term defined elsewhere is neither an ambiguity nor a judgment clause.

terms.source: 5 U.S.C. 8101(2), narrowed by state-law scope of practice
terms.operative_weight: Decides whose opinion can establish causal relationship at all. The chapter enumerates who is excluded rather than restating the definition.
Selects an acceptance type carrying no duration limit.
Splits into temporary and permanent, which carry different payable periods.
Compensation payable only for the established period, excluding the underlying disease.
Acceptance carries the same force as direct causation.
Duration of acceptance is contradicted within the paragraph. See F2.

terms.source: FECA PM 2-0805 para 7a, resting on Sandra Dixon-Mills, 44 ECAB 882 (1993)
terms.operative_weight: Extends compensability to natural consequences of an accepted injury.
Defeats the original relationship only by breaking the chain of causation.
Triggers referee referral under 5 U.S.C. 8123(a). Its own trigger is open. See F1.
Supplied as the factual background for a specialist opinion.
